## Hands-on 3 – Reproducing the recorded result {#hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result .smaller}

::: {.small}
- **Task 3** in your workspace or in the browser lab – the constrained specification: outcome `mcosmo`, unemployment centred, country and year fixed effects
- The data are one file, `EUframes_cy.csv`, loaded as the object `euframes`
- In the working script the model is written out for you to run; the browser lab version has gaps to fill, with two hints and a full solution
:::

::: {.fragment}
Target: **t = −3.804** – the value on record for analyst C6HJR. When you have it, type your t in chat and hold it until I say "go".
:::

::: notes
Now you work. Open the working script in your workspace and go to Task three. The code is written out there: it centres the unemployment rate on its grand mean, then fits the two-way fixed-effects model with fixest, so read it line by line as you run it. If you have fallen back on the browser lab, Task three there is a fill-the-gaps cell, with two hints and a fully worked solution underneath, and using either is not cheating, because this task is about the number at the end rather than the typing. You should land on t equals minus three point eight zero four, which is what Multi100 has on record for me. When you have it, type the t into chat but do not send – when I say "go", everyone sends at once. Twenty minutes. [wait for the numbers in chat]
:::
